text:
alex: Heads-up — getting a spike of KMS-decrypt alerts from the staging account over the last 10m, ~180 events. Looks like service-account churn from the deploy pipeline.
sec-bot: ALERT: KMS_DECRYPT_ANOMALY triggered (src: staging-deploy, count: 182, severity: medium) <https://siem.internal/alerts/1782003456>
ravi: Can you paste one of the raw events? need to know fields before tuning.
alex: here's an example (redacted):
```
{
  event_type: "kms.decrypt",
  principal: "svc-deploy-prod",
  key_id: "projects/redwood/keys/secrets-1",
  ip: "10.34.12.9",
  timestamp: "2026-02-12T21:42:03Z",
  request_id: "req-9f8a"
}
```
morgan: That principal should only hit production KMS. Why is staging hitting it? maybe rollback hook? Also dev loops often retry and hit thresholds.
jamie: We get a lot of noise from service accounts that rotate keys hourly. Suggest we add an enrichment to tag deploy-runner principals and exempt them from high-severity KMS alerts.
ravi: I want to avoid blanket whitelists. Proposal: change rule to: threshold count > 50 per 10m AND unique_ip_count > 5 OR not tagged as deploy-runner. That should catch horizontal scans but ignore legitimate churn.
alex: +1. Also add a suppression window for known deploy time (we have deploy windows at :05 and :35) so we don't noisy-alert during scheduled runs.
morgan: For engineering visibility, add a dashboard panel showing KMS decrypts by principal over 1h and 24h and a sparklines row. We can use that to verify tuning impact.
jamie: Here's a suggested KQL snippet we can test in the SIEM test index:
```
index=cloud_kms | where event_type=="kms.decrypt" | stats count by principal, src_ip | where count>10
```
ravi: After tuning we should run a simulated replay of last 72h to measure false-positive reduction and any missed true positives. I'll own the replay job.
alex: Can we also add audit-log enrichment with request_id -> deploy-run metadata (job id, ci-runner) so we can make rules that understand request provenance? That would reduce guesswork.
morgan: That requires plumbing the deploy CI to push metadata to the audit-log collector; I'll open a small PR. Owner: @morgan, ETA EOD tomorrow.
sec-bot: NOTE: suppression policy applied to rule KMS_DECRYPT_ANOMALY by ravi at 1782003498 (suppression window 2m during deploy runs).
ravi: Action items: 1) implement threshold change + unique_ip check (ravi) 2) add dashboard panels (morgan) 3) enrich audit logs with deploy metadata (morgan + infra) 4) schedule 72h replay (ravi) 5) update runbook with new suppression logic (jamie). I'll update the ticket and tag all owners. P0 -> downgraded to P2 while we tune.
jamie: I'll update the runbook and add a verification checklist for post-tune. small item: add unit-test for the sigma rule to the repo.
alex: Thanks — please post replay results and dashboard link once ready. :thumbsup:
ravi: will do, logging follow-ups in SIEM-1862. Closing noise incident for now, keep an eye on metrics. :eyes:
